summary: USANA Health Sciences filed an 8-K reporting a First Amendment, dated September 30, 2026, to its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Bank of America as administrative agent. The amendment resets a minimum Consolidated EBITDA covenant at $100 million (or $70 million if revolving exposure is $50 million or less), raises the general asset-sale basket from $500,000 to $2.5 million, and adds a new basket permitting USANA Australia Pty, Ltd to sell Sydney real property with proceeds applied at its discretion. Sale-leaseback transactions remain largely prohibited except as permitted by that new disposition basket.
